description: Sliding-frame window aggregates - ROWS BETWEEN ... - which run through the generic per-frame accumulator path shared by SUM, AVG, COUNT, MIN and MAX. A two-row trailing frame is asserted for all five, per partition, so the frame is seen both to slide and to stop at the partition boundary; and a running total over UNBOUNDED PRECEDING is asserted across an ordering that spans both partitions, so the same accumulator is shown carrying the whole result when nothing partitions it. Converted 1:1 from query/WindowFrameAggregateTest (now retired); the Java read individual cells by row and column index, so each converted test pins the whole ordered row set.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE wf (g VARCHAR, i INTEGER, x INTEGER)
SELECT g, i, SUM(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s FROM wf ORDER BY g, i
CREATE TABLE wf (g VARCHAR, i INTEGER, x INTEGER)

SELECT g, i, AVG(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a, COUNT(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c FROM wf ORDER BY g, i
CREATE TABLE wf (g VARCHAR, i INTEGER, x INTEGER)

SELECT g, i, MIN(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mn, MAX(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mx FROM wf ORDER BY g, i
CREATE TABLE wf (g VARCHAR, i INTEGER, x INTEGER)
SELECT i, SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY g, i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s FROM wf ORDER BY g, i
